name: nogbase
description: Real-estate sales workflows on Nogbase: the Nogbase connector with five skills for branded sales offers with every payment-plan installment, client shortlists from a buyer brief, project briefs in English or Arabic, deal checks that present Nogbase's investment estimate for a unit, and Nogbase actions that update units, leads, holds and other records. It reads and changes Nogbase data within your permissions and asks before each change.

interface.longDescription:
Nogbase helps real-estate brokers and property developers work with their Nogbase inventory, including off-plan projects. Search projects and units by area, developer, bedrooms, budget and currency, handover date, amenities, and payment-plan terms; compare projects for a client; read project details, brochures, and images; and prepare a sales offer or project brief with every payment-plan installment and your company letterhead. Developers can also review their own projects and recent inventory changes.

This plugin includes five skills that guide these workflows step by step: Sales offer (a branded offer for one unit at the quoted price, with every installment computed by Nogbase), Client shortlist (a buyer brief turned into filtered searches and a side-by-side comparison), Project brief (a project summary in English, Arabic, or both), Deal check (Nogbase's investment estimate for one unit from DLD sales, with sources, as-of dates and a disclaimer; an estimate, not advice), and Nogbase actions (changes such as a unit price, a lead note or a hold, and any other Nogbase API operation, each shown to you and confirmed before it is made).

The connector reads and changes Nogbase data within your own permissions in the connected workspace, and asks before each change; changes that need approval wait for it. A Nogbase broker or developer account is required.
defaultPrompt: Find off-plan 2-bedroom apartments in Jumeirah Village Circle under AED 1,500,000 with a 60/40 payment plan.
Prepare a one-page sales offer for unit 518 in Hesperine Arena at AED 1,000,000 on my company letterhead.
Deal-check unit 518 in Hesperine Arena at a rent of AED 90,000 a year: what would the buyer make selling at handover?
